name: list_home_profiles
description: Home sizes for the ballpark step (2br_apt, 3br_house, …). Scope: quote.

description.name: ballpark_estimate
description.description: Instant estimate range from home size + addresses. Free; never bookable. Scope: quote.

description.name: request_visit
description.description: Ask the mover to visit (or call) instead of filming. Free, never billed, creates no job; the mover gets it by email, on the dashboard and as `visit.requested`. Scope: quote.

description.name: create_job
description.description: Start a job (the survey container). Contact details are NOT accepted here — funnel rule. Send `Idempotency-Key` so a retry cannot create a second job. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: list_jobs
description.description: List jobs for the tenant, newest first. Secret key only. Paged: pass `limit` (1–100, default 25), optional `status`, and `cursor` from the previous page's `next_cursor` (null on the last page; a bad cursor is a 400). Scope: jobs:read.

description.name: get_job
description.description: Full job state: status, inventory, quote, access, terms, move_date. Scope: jobs:read.

description.name: set_contact
description.description: Store customer email + optional name + move date. Sends NOTHING — required before upload-url. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: create_upload_url
description.description: Presigned upload for the walkthrough video. Requires stored contact email. Body: { content_type, consent, size }. Send the byte size: at or above 16 MB the response carries `multipart` (an upload_id, a part_size and a presigned PUT per part) instead of `upload`, and each part is retried on its own r

description.name: complete_upload
description.description: Assemble a chunked upload. Body: { upload_id, parts: [{ part_number, etag }] }. Only after every part has been PUT; then call /submit. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: submit_job
description.description: Queue the uploaded video for analysis. Poll GET /jobs/{id} for status. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: hand_off_video
description.description: Server-side handoff: give us a public https URL of the walkthrough instead of uploading it from a browser. Secret key only. We fetch it (up to 500 MB, streamed) and the job runs exactly as an upload would — poll GET /jobs/{id}. Needs the stored contact email and consent, like /upload-url. Replaces /

description.name: confirm_access
description.description: Confirm floors / elevator / stairs / carry distance for both ends. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: edit_items
description.description: Edit inventory (quantity, exclude, add by item_key). Response carries the re-priced quote. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: approve_inventory
description.description: Customer sign-off on the inventory, plus free-text notes. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: send_inventory_to_mover
description.description: On a job the mover prices: the customer sends their list to the mover. Stamps the confirmation and locks the list. Body: { confirmed: true, notes }. Safe to repeat. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: list_appointment_times
description.description: Open times for a live video call or a home visit (`?kind=live|in_home`): inside the mover's hours, past their notice period, off their days off and clear of their booked appointments. Labels are in the mover's time zone. Scope: jobs:read.

description.name: request_appointment
description.description: Ask for a live video call or a home visit, offering up to 3 of the open times. A job with nothing uploaded switches to that kind and becomes priced by the mover. Re-posting replaces the offer until a time is agreed. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: accept_appointment_time
description.description: Accept the time the mover suggested. Both sides get a calendar file. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: cancel_appointment
description.description: Cancel the call or visit. The mover is told. The customer can book again. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: acknowledge_gaps
description.description: Record the customer's answer to the capture-gap prompts (inventory.gaps on GET /jobs/{id}). Body: { acknowledged: true } stamps "nothing is missing"; false clears it. The prompts themselves are recomputed from the current inventory on every read, so fixing a gap removes its prompt without this call.

description.name: send_resume_link
description.description: Email the customer their resume link. Only on explicit request. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: request_booking
description.description: Request the booking. Idempotent per job; requires approve:true (types-name-as-signature approval of the inventory + quote, stored with a quote snapshot) and accept_terms when the mover has terms. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: report_outcome
description.description: Report actuals (hours, final cents, crew). Secret key only. Scope: outcomes.

description.name: get_cube_sheet_csv
description.description: Itemized cube sheet as CSV (Excel-ready): rooms, volumes, weights, exclusions. Secret key only. Scope: jobs:read.

description.name: get_date_prices
description.description: This job's quote priced across a ~2-week window from the mover's date rules. flat=true means every day prices the same. Scope: jobs:read.

description.name: set_move_date
description.description: Set or clear the move date; invalidates and recomputes the quote. Refused after a booking is requested. Scope: jobs:write.

description.name: quote_inventory
description.description: Direct pricing for agents: items or total_cuft in, firm quote out. Secret key only. Scope: quote.

description.name: get_availability
description.description: Which days the mover has marked off, before a job exists. Soft: a marked day can still be requested — the mover confirms and calls first — so steer to an open day when the customer has a choice. Scope: quote.

description.name: list_keys
description.description: List the account's API keys — live and test, active and revoked. Never a raw secret. Secret key with the `keys` scope. Scope: keys.

description.name: create_key
description.description: Mint a key. The raw secret is in THIS response only. A key can never mint one broader than itself; a test key mints only test keys; a live secret key may mint the sandbox pair. Scope: keys.

description.name: rotate_key
description.description: Replace a key with its twin (same kind, mode, scopes, label). The old key keeps working until `replaced.expires_at` so a deploy can swap values without a gap. Needs the `keys` scope even to rotate itself — rotate a scoped key with a full key or from the dashboard. A key is rotated once: rotating it

description.name: revoke_key
description.description: Revoke a key immediately. The only live publishable key is refused (409) — rotate it instead. A test key cannot revoke a live key (403 `mode_mismatch`). Scope: keys.

description.name: list_webhook_deliveries
description.description: The delivery log: every webhook POST for 30 days, newest first, with its outcome and the exact body sent. Secret key with the `keys` scope. A key reads the deliveries of its own mode: live keys the live log, test keys the sandbox log. Scope: keys.

description.name: replay_webhook_delivery
description.description: Re-send one delivery to its endpoint: the same body byte for byte (same envelope id, so your dedupe still works) under a fresh signature, with the usual retries. Returns the replay's own delivery record. Deliveries of the other mode are not found (404). Scope: keys.

description.name: search_catalog
description.description: Search the cube-sheet catalog (?q=sofa&job_id=...). Scope: quote.

description.name: suggest_addresses
description.description: Address autocomplete (proxied; send session_token). Scope: quote.

description.name: resolve_address
description.description: Resolve a suggestion to a full address (same session_token). Scope: quote.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hand_off_video, list_webhook_deliveries · Private data: create_job, list_jobs, set_contact, create_upload_url, hand_off_video, accept_appointment_time, acknowledge_gaps, report_outcome, get_cube_sheet_csv, quote_inventory, list_keys, create_key, list_webhook_deliveries, replay_webhook_delivery · Public sink: request_visit, create_job, set_contact, create_upload_url, complete_upload, submit_job, hand_off_video, send_inventory_to_mover, send_resume_link, list_webhook_deliveries, replay_webhook_delivery, suggest_addresses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hand_off_video, list_webhook_deliveries · Private data: create_job, list_jobs, set_contact, create_upload_url, hand_off_video, accept_appointment_time, acknowledge_gaps, report_outcome, get_cube_sheet_csv, quote_inventory, list_keys, create_key, list_webhook_deliveries, replay_webhook_delivery · Public sink: request_visit, create_job, set_contact, create_upload_url, complete_upload, submit_job, hand_off_video, send_inventory_to_mover, send_resume_link, list_webhook_deliveries, replay_webhook_delivery, suggest_addresses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the cube-sheet catalog (?q=sofa). Scope: quote." → after: "Search the cube-sheet catalog (?q=sofa&job_id=...). Scope: quote."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
